2: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
3: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
4: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
5: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
6: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
7: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
8: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
